subject: Request: trial top-up for Spring Launch newsletter cohort
messages:
From: Ava Sun <ava@weeklylabs.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: partnerships@weeklylabs.ai
Date: 2026-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Trial top-up request for Spring Launch newsletter cohort

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team was impressed by Redwood's latency and cost controls. We're planning a Spring Launch edition of our WeeklyLabs newsletter (send planned for 2026-02-05) to ~12k engaged subscribers. We'd like to include a trial offer that gives selected readers a 14-day trial of Redwood's hosted API (for experimentation and to drive dev signups).

Request: 200 trial bundles (single-use promo codes, 14-day validity) + a separate set of 50 extended trials (30-day validity) for VIP partners. We can provide the segmentation and CSV of emails (attached: newsletter-cohort-segmentation.pdf, trial-batch-list.csv).

Key asks:
- Can Redwood approve this promo allocation and generate unique codes with a WL- prefix?
- Delivery deadline: codes delivered by 2026-01-22 so our ops team can stitch them into the campaign template.
- Is there any objection to making the VIP codes non-redeemable in certain regions (we can provide the list)?

We'd also like to have tracking parameters so we can see signups attributed to the campaign in HubSpot. Happy to sign any simple T&Cs.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock the audience.

Best,
Ava Sun
Head of Partnerships, WeeklyLabs
ava@weeklylabs.ai
+1 (206) 555-0198

Attachments: newsletter-cohort-segmentation.pdf (5 pages), trial-batch-list.csv (sample 20 rows)

Thanks Ava — this looks straightforward and high signal. Marcus / Marissa, looping you in to confirm operational capacity and approval.

My read: we can approve the 200 standard 14-day trial codes + 50 VIP 30-day codes out of our promo pool. A couple of operational notes:
- Marcus: can your ops team produce single-use codes with prefix WL- and set expirations (14/30 days)? We should also add a referral UTM so WeeklyLabs can be attributed in our analytics.
- Marissa: please confirm whether we can reserve the JV allocation under deal WL-4731 and whether finance needs a PO or simply a marketing request form.

If we can deliver by 2026-01-22 we should be safe for a Feb 5 send. Ava — can you confirm region opt-outs if any?

If no objections by EOD Monday 1/12, I'll mark this approved.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
